name: zdeclient_append_feature_entry
description: zDEClient::AppendFeatureEntry appends crater or quicksand event records to the global feature-entry vector and grows the vector when full.
known_limits: The original body has VC-era vector insertion branches and one Binary Ninja note marks an unreachable capacity branch as live. Tier C equivalence covers the append/growth behavior needed by source dependencies; tier S is deferred to the zDEClient vector/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457840 validates accepting feature types 1 and 3, copying the matching event-template byte count into a local feature entry, setting reloadFlag to zero, growing the global feature-entry vector when no capacity remains, preserving old entries, appending one new entry, and returning zero.

The native append smoke verifies invalid type no-op behavior, crater append into an empty vector, quicksand append through the growth path, preservation of the prior entry, appended payload data, reloadFlag clearing, and global begin/end/capacity updates.
